description: Refactor: extract diff parsing into its own module — bare except, os.path usage
pr_diff:
diff --git a/src/tools/diff_parser.py b/src/tools/diff_parser.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b2c3d4e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/tools/diff_parser.py
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+import os
+import re
+
+
+def parse_diff_files(diff: str):
+    """Extract filenames from a unified diff string."""
+    files = []
+    for line in diff.splitlines():
+        if line.startswith("diff --git"):
+            # Extract b/ path
+            match = re.search(r"b/(.+)$", line)
+            if match:
+                files.append(match.group(1))
+    return files
+
+
+def count_diff_lines(diff_path: str):
+    """Count added/removed lines in a diff file on disk."""
+    added = 0
+    removed = 0
+    try:
+        content = open(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), diff_path)).read()
+        for line in content.splitlines():
+            if line.startswith("+") and not line.startswith("+++"):
+                added += 1
+            elif line.startswith("-") and not line.startswith("---"):
+                removed += 1
+    except:
+        pass
+    return {"added": added, "removed": removed}
